options.B: Local maxima at $x\approx -1.645,\ 0.544$; local minima at $x\approx -0.544,\ 1.645$; absolute maximum $\approx 3.631$ at $x\approx -1.645$ and absolute minimum $\approx -3.631$ at $x\approx 1.645$.
options.C: Local maxima at $x\approx -1.645,\ 0.544$; local minima at $x\approx -0.544,\ 1.645$; absolute maximum $\approx 1.419$ at $x\approx 0.544$ and absolute minimum $\approx -40.99$ at $x\approx -1.645$.
